race.title: Annual Members At Huntingdon Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: He may well have been no match for an odds-on favourite on his recent hurdling debut, but MY MATE AJ showed plenty to work on, so he gets the verdict to go a place better for the in-form Ben Pauling yard. The obvious danger is Double The Dance , who found one too strong in all 3 bumper starts last season and should make his mark as a hurdler. Talladale may prove best of the rest. MY MATE AJ (IRE) DOUBLE THE DANCE (IRE) TALLADALE
race.bettingForecast: My Mate Aj (6/4), Double The Dance (7/4), Talladale (6/1), Donegal (8/1), Big Win (14/1), Trapper John (20/1), Aspull (33/1), Vinne (66/1)
